page.overview:
What is Foecleaver?

Foecleaver was Adam Carthalion’s magical sword. Years after Adam's death, Eusomoné gave the sword to Jared Carthalion. It was almost destroyed when Jared battled a thunder spirit, but it was restored and improved upon by Kristina of the Woods.
